Writing Quality Studio v0.4.0

Complete Studio-owned voice, revision and spoken-writing workflows.

Download v0.4.0 ZIPOpen the original release

Record notes

Complete Studio-owned voice, revision and spoken-writing workflows.

The maintained Studio should include complete reusable methods. Earlier public packaging incorrectly routed ordinary work to separate method installations.

Included voice-sample, brand/tone and spoken-composition procedures replace method-pack handoffs. Revision, multilingual/learning and specialist prose routes use existing included procedures. Previously queued collaborative writing is included in the same release.

Also included in this accumulated batch:

  • Adds one conditional collaborative-writing reference covering fragment capture, structure and complete drafts.
  • Makes beat-by-beat collaboration an explicit opt-in, so a normal drafting request still receives a complete draft.
  • Preserves source uncertainty, authorial choices and current edits instead of silently overwriting them.
  • Updates the existing skill route, project map, MIT attribution and generated package metadata.

Selected procedural adaptations from mattpocock/skills at commit 49dd158d1076134a641b33efb035946536778336 retain exact source paths and complete MIT notices. No upstream installer, runtime, hook, dependency or timed schedule is included.

Compatibility: Compatible included-method expansion. Existing plugin and skill identifiers remain. Historical local method anchors resolve internally. Actual application, service and runtime requirements are preserved.

Upgrade: Update the existing Studio or Toolkit package. Use its normal skill entrypoints; no additional writing, UX or prompt method pack is needed.

Validation: Changed skill frontmatter and local reference closure checked. Bounded source-grounded procedure cases run without the redundant method packs; UX instruction-coverage checks are separate from real workbook/browser interaction or participant tests. Exact release archive, installation parity and catalog checks are recorded by the release workflow.

Additional integration checks: Adds an explicit, evidence-linked editorial rubric for requested ratings and draft comparisons. Native voice adaptations are operative routes; detector and authorship claims remain excluded.

Cross-Studio review: Aligns selected writing-template handoffs with the actual verified collection contract, replacing stale resource counts and unsupported fallback claims while preserving native drafting.

Notes source: github-release:409984013
